title: Extreme Geometric Quantiles Under Minimal Assumptions, with a Connection to Tukey Depth
summary: Geometric (also known as spatial) quantiles, introduced by Chaudhury and representing one of the three principal approaches to defining multivariate quantiles, have been well studied in the literature. In this work, we focus on the extremal behaviour of these quantiles. We establish new extremal properties, namely general lower and upper bounds for the norm of extreme geometric quantiles, free of any moment conditions.
